market_pulse.note: Fell 9.89% to about $55,789 as of 12:56 AM ET Saturday, its lowest since September 2024 and below the prior 2026 low near $57,700; a later CoinGabbar reading put it near $57,900, down 6.2% over 24 hours (Yahoo Finance/Investing.com; CoinGabbar).
Fell 10.12% to about $1,564 as of 12:56 AM ET Saturday; CoinGabbar later put it near $1,638, down 6.4% over 24 hours and 13.5% over the week (Yahoo Finance/Investing.com; CoinGabbar).
About $2.07 trillion, down 5.6% over 24 hours, per CoinGabbar's Nov. 21 report (CoinGabbar).
About 58.4% on CoinMarketCap's measure, with Ether at about 9.8% (CoinMarketCap).

themes.title: Bitcoin hits lowest since 2024
themes.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $56,000 early Saturday, more than half below its record above $126,000 set in October 2025 and about 28% lower for the quarter (Yahoo Finance/Investing.com).

themes.title: $2.55 billion liquidated
themes.summary: About $2.55 billion of leveraged positions were liquidated over 24 hours, about 89% of them longs, including $1.16 billion in Bitcoin and $584 million in Ether, per CoinGlass data (CoinGabbar; Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: ETF outflows continue
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs had $124.4 million of net outflows on Nov. 20 and about $4.44 billion over 30 days, per SoSoValue; BlackRock's IBIT had a record $541.1 million outflow on Nov. 19 (CoinGabbar; CoinMarketCap).

themes.title: Fed hike bets and tech selloff
themes.summary: CME data shows an 88.6% chance of a Fed rate increase on Dec. 9, and Fed Governor Christopher Waller raised the possibility of a half-point move; the Nasdaq fell 5.3% on Friday (CoinGabbar; Yahoo Finance; AP).

themes.title: Extreme fear
themes.summary: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index read 12 on Nov. 21, in extreme fear, compared with 68 a month ago (CoinGabbar).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin and Ether each fell roughly 10% over 24 hours to early Saturday, to about $55,789 and $1,564 (Yahoo Finance/Investing.com).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: XRP fell about 10.1% to $0.8726, Solana about 9.9% to $65.54 and BNB about 10.6% to $511.34 (Yahoo Finance/Investing.com).

categories.name: Crypto stocks
categories.note: Hut 8 fell nearly 15%, and Core Scientific, CleanSpark and Bitdeer each fell more than 13% (Yahoo Finance/Investing.com).

categories.name: Crypto ETFs
categories.note: Spot Ether ETFs had $13.2 million of outflows on Nov. 20 and XRP ETFs $5.0 million, per SoSoValue; spot Bitcoin ETF net assets stood near $26.9 billion (CoinGabbar).

watch_list.why: Analysts cited by CoinGabbar watch $52,000 to $55,000 as the next support area and $60,000 to $62,000 as resistance; Wintermute says a sustained recovery would need a move back above $68,000 with renewed ETF inflows (CoinGabbar; Yahoo Finance).
MSCI is set to remove Strategy (MSTR), a large Bitcoin holder, from some U.S. indexes after the close on Nov. 30 (CoinStats).
Spot ETFs do not trade on weekends; next week brings October PCE inflation data on Nov. 25 ahead of the Dec. 9 Fed decision (CoinGabbar; Admirals).

movers.name: BNB (BNB)
movers.note: Down about 10.6% to near $511.34 as of 12:56 AM ET Saturday (Yahoo Finance/Investing.com).

movers.name: Dogecoin (DOGE)
movers.note: Down about 10.5% over 24 hours as of early Saturday (Yahoo Finance/Investing.com).
